name: Number of partitions of n into 3 positive cubes.
comment: If A025455(n) > 0 then a(n + k^3) > 0 for k>0; a(A119977(n))>0; a(A003072(n))>0. - _Reinhard Zumkeller_, Jun 03 2006
The first term > 1 is a(251) = 2. - _Michel Marcus_, Apr 23 2019

Hardy and Littlewood conjectured (K hypothesis) that the number of representations of n as the sum of k many k-th powers is less than n^o(1). However for k=3 (this sequence) the hypothesis has been disproven by Mahler in 1936. - _Elijah Beregovsky_, Oct 02 2025

Index entries for sequences related to sums of cubes
formula: a(n) = [x^n y^3] Product_{k>=1} 1/(1 - y*x^(k^3)). - _Ilya Gutkovskiy_, Apr 23 2019
There exists a constant c such that a(n) >> n^(c/log log n) (proved independently by Erdős and Chowla&Pillai). - _Elijah Beregovsky_, Oct 02 2025
